title: Ye Rooke Kehti Thi Maadar Sakina Sojao
body:
Ye rooke kehti thi maadar Sakina sojao.
Hai dar pa shimr e sitamgar Sakina sojao.
1. Yahan na bhai chacha aayenge bachane ko.
Nahi hai baap bhi sar par Sakina sojao.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tamache maare rasan bhi galay may baandhi hai.
Phiraya kaanto pa dar dar Sakina sojao.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Isii maqam pe ghut ghut ke marr hii jayenge.
Yahi hai aaqri ab ghar Sakina sojao.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Gale ke dard se tum isa qadar tadapti ho.
Sunayegi kise aaqer Sakina sojao.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Nikal ke qaid e sitam se bhi jaa nahi sakte.
Hamara jeena hai doo bhar Sakina sojao.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Andheri raat hai zindan par bhi pehra hai
Yahi hai apna muqaddar Sakina sojao
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tasalli dene ko zinda may aagaya bibi
Rasool zaad e ka ab sar Sakina sojao
Azz: abul Qasim abedi.
